paper_title: Searching for dark matter with a 1000 km baseline interferometer
notes: Paper constrains three couplings: g_aNN (neutron, Fig 4), g_aPP (proton, Fig 5), g_aee (electron, Fig 6), all in GeV^-1 gradient coupling convention (H = g grad(a).sigma). Extracted neutron coupling per hint. Data points approximate from Fig 4 smoothed mean-limit curve; best sensitivity ~1e-9 GeV^-1 near ma=2e-17 eV. Mass range 1e-22 to 4e-14 eV (frequency 1e-8 to 11.6 Hz). Note this g_aNN convention is dimensionful (GeV^-1) not the dimensionless g_an typically expected; conversion to dimensionless would require g_an = g_aNN * 2*m_n. 95% CL via CLs method. Local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 10))
